units.text: EXT. GLACIER CREVASSE LEDGE - DAWN
A blue throat of ice drops away into dark.
Forty feet down, on a shelf barely wider than a door, a man and a woman cling together in the frozen quiet.
His left leg is bent wrong.
She has one crampon and a rope that ends in frayed threads.
TOBIAS ANSELM (40s, beard crusted white) tries to sit upright.
He gasps and slides back against the wall.
MARGUERITE DELACROIX-ODUYA (30s, climbing helmet cracked at the brow) crouches beside him, working a splint from a tent pole and webbing.
She does not look at his face.
She looks at the knot.
Leave it. Go up.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Shut up and hold the pole.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: He holds it.
His hands shake.
She pulls the strap tight and he screams, a sound that echoes down and never comes back.
A hiss from her chest pocket.
She freezes, then fumbles out a handheld radio.
Team Four, Base. We have you on the thermal. Hold position. Helicopter wheels up in forty.
units.name: RANGER

units.text: Relief breaks across her face.
She laughs, a cracked sound, and kisses the radio.
Copy, Base. Two alive. One leg. Please hurry.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Copy two alive. Wind is picking up on the ridge. Stay low.
units.name: RANGER

units.text: She turns to him, grinning for the first time.
Forty minutes. You hear that?
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: I heard.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: He says it too calmly.
She notices his lips, which are turning grey.
She tears off her glove and presses two fingers to his neck.
No. No no no. Stay with me, you stubborn old goat.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: He opens his eyes.
Faintly, he smiles.
Above them, the ice groans.
A fine rain of snow sifts down.
She pulls him against her chest and tucks her jacket around them both.
Team Four, Base. Weather window closing. Say again your status.
units.name: RANGER

units.text: She stares at the radio, then at the dark beyond the ledge.
She keys it.
Base, we are not going anywhere. Tell them to hurry.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: She sets the radio on his chest, where he can hear it.
The ice groans again, and this time something far below answers.
